g.title: E46_PEDAL
g.text: 6-pin dual-track hall-effect sensor. Two fully independent circuits. Total current draw: ~20 mA. 24 AWG wire sufficient on all pins. APS2 voltage is intentionally ~half APS1 at every pedal position. MaxxECU cross-checks ratio -- disagreement triggers e-throttle shutdown. Bench-verified pinout: HP Academy forum + openinverter.org BMW pedal wiki. Source used E46 pedal: eBay $30-80. New OEM: ~$130-140. Adapter bracket: Strom Motorsports / Garagistic / Boost Monkey / Drift HQ (~$40-60 each). RHD fitment unconfirmed -- contact vendor before ordering.

g.title: CABLE_PEDAL_TO_MAXXECU
g.text: MAXXECU_SUPPLY:2:CMC H1 (Sensor GND) — shared sensor ground bus
MAXXECU_SUPPLY:2:CMC H1 (Sensor GND) — shared sensor ground bus
MAXXECU_SUPPLY:1:CMC G1 (+5V sensor supply) — shared with TPS/MAP/CLT/CAM
MAXXECU_SUPPLY:1:CMC G1 (+5V sensor supply) — shared with TPS/MAP/CLT/CAM

Cabin footwell → Maven HD30 Connector B (cabin face, at firewall) — 6 wires crossing to engine-bay MaxxECU via Connector B pins 1-6 under the H2O arch. Cabin-side run only in this cable file — the engine-side hop (Maven engine face → MaxxECU C2/CMC) is documented in harnesses/firewall-crossing-maven.wv. Route the cabin portion along the tunnel/sill, away from audio wiring. 24 AWG sufficient -- total circuit draw ~20 mA. Shielded 6-conductor; drain shield at MaxxECU end only (single-end drain prevents ground loops). Tie drain wire to CMC H1 (Sensor GND). Wire 1 BN: APS1 GND (pedal pin 1) → MAXXECU_SUPPLY GND bus (CMC H1). Wire 2 BN: APS2 GND (pedal pin 2) → MAXXECU_SUPPLY GND bus (CMC H1). Wire 3 RD: VCC2 (pedal pin 3) → MAXXECU_SUPPLY +5V rail (CMC G1). Wire 4 WH: APS1 signal (pedal pin 4) → MAXXECU_C2 E4 (AIN 6). Wire 5 RD: VCC1 (pedal pin 5) → MAXXECU_SUPPLY +5V rail (CMC G1). Wire 6 WH: APS2 signal (pedal pin 6) → MAXXECU_C2 F1 (AIN 7).

g.title: MAXXECU_C2
g.text: MaxxECU RACE GEN1 C2 connector (32-pin Molex CMC)
Cabin-mounted ECU -- APS signal inputs at C2 E4 (AIN 6) and C2 F1 (AIN 7)
Confirmed from MaxxECU RACE GEN1 C2 pinout:

Source: maxxecu.com/webhelp/wirings-maxxecu_pinout.html AIN 5 (C2 G3) is already occupied by the virtual clutch position sensor (see maxxecu-m52.wv ECU_C2). AIN 6 and AIN 7 are the next available inputs. MTune path: Settings → E-Throttle → Pedal position → assign AIN 6 (APS1) and AIN 7 (APS2). Run e-throttle calibration wizard after wiring.

g.title: MAXXECU_SUPPLY
g.text: MaxxECU RACE main CMC supply rails
+5V sensor supply (CMC G1) and Sensor GND (CMC H1) -- shared bus
CMC G1 (+5V sensor supply) — shared with TPS/MAP/CLT/CAM
CMC H1 (Sensor GND) — shared sensor ground bus

Both APS circuits (VCC1 and VCC2) tap the same MaxxECU +5V sensor supply rail (CMC G1). Both APS sensor grounds (GND1 and GND2) return to the sensor GND bus (CMC H1). The ECU_16PIN aux breakout (pin 1 = +5V, pin 2 = Sensor GND) is an equivalent tap point if routing from the breakout connector is more convenient. MaxxECU +5V rail is rated 150 mA continuous (from ECU_16PIN note). APS draws ~20 mA total -- well within budget shared with other sensors. Do NOT connect APS GND to chassis GND or engine GND (C2 G4). Must go to sensor GND bus.
